architecture.mechanism: Temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance and contact resistance variability in battery systems
architecture.intervention: Implement a cold-weather diagnostic threshold in the BMS that increases the charging current minimum threshold or compensates voltage readings for low-temperature internal resistance changes at idle
architecture.expected_effect: The battery warning light will no longer trigger falsely during cold-idle conditions due to transient voltage drops misinterpreted as charging faults
architecture.falsification_test: Measure the battery terminal voltage and internal resistance using a calibrated multimeter and EIS tester at engine idle with ambient temperature below 0°C; if the voltage recovers above the BMS fault threshold within 5 seconds of applying a load or raising the temperature, the hypothesis is confirmed
